blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is once again leading the way in promoting economic empowerment and community development through its expansive Nationwide Job Fair Initiative. In strong partnership with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) and the Public Employment Service Office (PESO) of various local government units, this initiative connects thousands of job seekers with employment opportunities across both the private and public sectors, creating meaningful pathways to career growth and financial stability.

blocks.cap: Applicants engage with recruiters at Robinsons Malls’ job fair

blocks.html: Building on the success of 2024—where over 120 job fairs were held across 47 Robinsons Malls, attracting more than 51,000 applicants and resulting in over 5,000 hires on the spot (HOTS)—Robinsons Malls plans to further expand the initiative in 2025. With over 170 job fairs scheduled this year, the program will have an even greater reach, solidifying Robinsons Malls as one of the country’s largest enablers of private-sector employment.

After the success of last year’s collaboration with over 3,000 companies and partners, Robinsons Malls is targeting a broader industry engagement in 2025. The job fairs will offer opportunities across a wide range of sectors, including retail, services, agriculture, manufacturing, and public services. Employers will benefit from direct access to a diverse, qualified talent pool, helping accelerate recruitment and workforce expansion.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Malls connects talents with opportunities this Labor Day

blocks.html: The expanded job fair series will kick off on April 30 at Robinsons Malolos, followed by simultaneous Labor Day events on May 1 at multiple locations: Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Antipolo, Robinsons Iloilo, Robinsons Butuan, Robinsons Iligan, Robinsons Las Piñas, Robinsons Palawan, Robinsons Pangasinan, Robinsons Ilocos, and Robinsons Santiago. Additional job fairs will be held on May 2 at Robinsons Imus, Robinsons General Trias, and Robinsons Lipa; on May 9 at Robinsons Tuguegarao; and on May 23 at Robinsons Gapan.

These job fairs are part of Robinsons Malls’ broader mission through its Lingkod Pinoy Center, which provides accessible government services, livelihood support, and career advancement opportunities nationwide. The job fairs will continue beyond Labor Day, with a series of events scheduled throughout the year. For updates on schedules, participating companies, and application requirements, follow Robinsons Malls on its official social media pages.
